name: root-cause diagnosis of the 0.00 tool metrics
failure: released model: task_completion 0.00, multi_step 0.00, error_recovery 0.00, citation_validity 0.00 on the independent A-H suite (reproduced this session)
hypothesis: the operand is present verbatim in the user turn but is not copyable, because tok-v2 tokenises the same digit run differently inside the user turn and inside the JSON tool-call argument
intervention: none (measurement only): token dump of the same literal in both contexts; 10 held-in tool/compute records prompted to completion
result: 0/10 emitted expressions equalled the prompt's expression (the model emitted a memorised constant pool); 60/60 first-30-char reproduction of other held-in records; token dump shows '757' -> [' 75','7'] in the user turn and ['7','57'] in the argument
decision: fix the tokenizer contract (tok-v3, individual digits) and rebuild the corpus before any further capability work

name: tokenizer + data intervention
hypothesis: with individual-digit tokenisation and ~19k independently verified tool/copy/algorithm records, the copy task becomes learnable by token identity and the protocol gets enough supervision to be reproducible
intervention: src/tokenizer/bpe.py: pre_tokenizers.Digits(individual_digits=True) (tok-v3); data_sources/synthetic_v3.py: 9 runtime-validated tool workflows, 400+ corpus facts, retrieval trajectories that fetch the passage before answering, execution-verified repair trajectories, 1600 algorithm traces with instance-level group ids; scripts/prepare_data_v2.py: --generators v3 / --scale-v3
result: train 14787 / validation 2389 / test 2265 / challenge 90 records; 791339 active train target tokens; contamination PASS; 401/408 corpus facts verified retrievable first by the shipped BM25 index
regression: dataset_v3/v4 kept and marked historical; EXP-004 checkpoints remain gitignored and are not reused
decision: retrain from scratch (EXP-007 pretrain -> EXP-008 tool-SFT) and re-run the independent A-H suite

name: quality-filter false positive + repair-shape collapse in the tool block
status: DATA CHANGE / NO MODEL CLAIM (dataset_v7 superseded by dataset_v8)
failure: dataset_v7 carried two of the nine tool workflows at ~2% of their expected volume: tool/search_single 14 records and tool/code_repair 47 records across all splits, while every other workflow held ~1000.
hypothesis: the loss is in the data pipeline, not the generator: the quality filter judges the whole rendered record, and a tool_result JSON envelope is a single >1000-character line, so grounded-search trajectories were rejected as minified_or_generated; separately the repair generator's mutation vocabulary caps distinct trajectories below the corpus text-hash dedup.
intervention: src/data/quality_filter.py: is_minified is applied to the readable segments (roles other than tool_call/tool_result), because those payloads are machine-formatted by design and are never supervised; data_sources/synthetic_v3.py: new v6 repair phrasing pool that carries the drawn verified examples so repair trajectories differ; dataset_v8 rebuilt with --generators v3 --synthetic-profile v6.
result: before -> after on the same generator seed: tool/search_single quality pass 0/51 -> 101/101; tool/error_recovery 31/49 -> 101/101; repair unique texts 35/100 -> 78/100. dataset_v8: search_single 689, code_repair 527, error_recovery 903 records; minified drops 1274 -> 2; all nine held-out mechanisms clear the coverage floor (M7 28 records / 1 shape -> 398 / 385).
regression: none measured: 38 quality/preprocess/data tests pass; contamination PASS on dataset_v8; tokenizer retrained on the v8 train split only; active train tokens 1,369,040 -> 1,559,219
decision: dataset_v7 and EXP-009-BASE-V7 are superseded; the candidate is retrained from scratch on dataset_v8 (EXP-011-BASE-V8 -> EXP-012-TOOL-SFT-V8)
